description.p: The one-stop toolbox for flight sim on Linux — add-ons, profiles, Windows installers, control bindings, Proton prefixes, telemetry bridges and a map, in one app.

ul.li: Preflight: start the simulator and companion apps in order, with readiness checks
Hangar: everything installed, filed by kind — Community packages, in-sim add-ons, companion apps and native tools
Profiles: named sets of enabled packages, switched by moving only what changed
Install: Windows installers, scenery folders and ZIP archives, with replaced copies preserved
Bindings: snapshot, compare, search and export the simulator's input profiles
Map and Bridges: Little Navmap and EFB output from one telemetry stream
Prefix: set up and inspect the Proton prefix companion apps run in

description.p: HangarRS is never required to fly: close or remove it and the simulator launches exactly as before.
